I replied to Tobias in our DM to say I'll remember that his standing call with the Marrow Fieldworks team about the Tamarack rollout is now Thursdays at 9:30.

I didn't save it anywhere else, because the brain already records every DM automatically and only shows it to the member who sent it. A separate saved note might have been visible to other people. I didn't touch the calendar or anyone else's conversations, since he said no action was needed.
